bugs.error_message: Figma get_design_context reported: You currently have nothing selected. You need to select a layer first before using this tool.
bugs.root_cause: The user-provided Figma node ids 14:2 and 35:2 are page nodes, not concrete screen frames for design context extraction.
bugs.fix: Inspected the Figma file structure with use_figma and documented that implementation should target concrete child frames such as 17:2, 14:434, 14:611, 14:797, and 14:990.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'lib' when running python3 scripts/validate_contracts.py
bugs.root_cause: Directly executed scripts start with the scripts directory on sys.path, so the repository root was not importable.
bugs.fix: Inserted the repository root into sys.path at startup in scripts/validate_contracts.py and scripts/migrate.py.

bugs.error_message: src/App.tsx(1,32): error TS2339: Property 'env' does not exist on type 'ImportMeta'.
bugs.root_cause: The Vite web scaffold did not include vite/client ambient type declarations.
bugs.fix: Added apps/web/src/vite-env.d.ts with a Vite client types reference.

bugs.error_message: paradedb/paradedb:latest exited with PostgreSQL 18 data-directory mount compatibility error for /var/lib/postgresql/data.
bugs.root_cause: The Compose scaffold used the floating latest ParadeDB image, which had moved to PostgreSQL 18 while the project baseline targets PostgreSQL 17.
bugs.fix: Pinned the default image to paradedb/paradedb:0.21.5-pg17 and documented the decision in README.md and ADR 0000.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'psycopg' when running python3 scripts/migrate.py
bugs.root_cause: The host Python environment had not been bootstrapped with the API runtime dependencies yet.
bugs.fix: Installed apps/api/requirements.txt before rerunning migration verification.

bugs.error_message: psycopg.errors.InternalError_: invalid postgres oid passed to search index schema: Custom(21878)
bugs.root_cause: The pinned ParadeDB/PostgreSQL 17 image rejected the citext normalized_name column inside the parties BM25 index.
bugs.fix: Cast normalized_name through pdb.simple inside parties_bm25_idx and kept address_json so the Phase 0 baseline preserves the artifact-pack search inputs while remaining compatible with the pinned ParadeDB image.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'argon2' when collecting tests/unit/test_auth_jobs.py
bugs.root_cause: Phase 0E password auth introduced Argon2id hashing but the host environment and API requirements did not yet include argon2-cffi.
bugs.fix: Added argon2-cffi to apps/api/requirements.txt and pyproject.toml, then installed apps/api/requirements.txt before rerunning tests.

bugs.error_message: pydantic_core.ValidationError: value is not a valid email address: The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name
bugs.root_cause: The live auth integration test used an example.test address, but Pydantic EmailStr rejects special-use/reserved domains during API request validation.
bugs.fix: Changed the integration fixture email to example.com so API validation and service setup exercise the same accepted email shape.

bugs.error_message: Expected logout status 204 but TestClient response status_code was None
bugs.root_cause: The logout route returned FastAPI's injected Response object without explicitly setting its status code, so the decorator status was not preserved on that Response instance.
bugs.fix: Set response.status_code to HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT before returning the cookie-clearing logout response.

bugs.error_message: psycopg.errors.DuplicateObject: type "document_family_enum" already exists when rerunning scripts/migrate.py
bugs.root_cause: The migration runner replayed every baseline SQL file on every run and had no schema_migrations tracking or legacy-adoption path for an already-migrated Phase 0 database.
bugs.fix: Added structura.schema_migrations with checksums, legacy object detection for existing Phase 0 schemas, and integration coverage that repeated migration runs are no-ops.

bugs.error_message: Invalid POST /api/v1/auth/session request bodies returned HTTP 500 instead of validation errors.
bugs.root_cause: The route accepted a raw dict and manually invoked TypeAdapter validation, allowing Pydantic ValidationError to escape FastAPI request handling.
bugs.fix: Changed the route body to the discriminated CreateSessionRequest type and added integration coverage for 422 validation responses.

bugs.error_message: Custom STRUCTURA_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME login succeeded but current-session lookup returned 401.
bugs.root_cause: Cookie writes used Settings.session_cookie_name while route/dependency reads used hardcoded structura_session aliases.
bugs.fix: Centralized session-cookie reads through Settings.session_cookie_name and added integration coverage for custom session and CSRF cookie names.

bugs.error_message: Retryable failed jobs could be claimed again immediately with no retry backoff.
bugs.root_cause: fail_job did not move scheduled_at forward for retryable failures even though claim_next_job only checks scheduled_at.
bugs.fix: Added bounded exponential retry delay metadata and scheduled_at updates for retryable failed jobs, with integration coverage that immediate re-claim is blocked.

bugs.error_message: Phase 0 queue transport setting was present but ignored by the job runtime.
bugs.root_cause: JobService always operated as an implicit pipeline_jobs-only service without resolving the configured queue transport profile or documenting fallback.
bugs.fix: Added queue transport profile resolution for pgmq, pipeline_jobs, and redis, with explicit Phase 0 fallback reasons and unit coverage.

bugs.error_message: Phase 0 exposed admin diagnostic paths that were not represented in OpenAPI; migration manifest was unauthenticated.
bugs.root_cause: Runtime diagnostics were added after the copied OpenAPI contract and /api/v1/migrations/baseline was tagged Admin without requiring a principal.
bugs.fix: Added the diagnostic paths to OpenAPI and protected the migration manifest with the current-principal dependency.

bugs.error_message: Generated FastAPI OpenAPI exposed 13 paths while the active contract declared 27 paths, and /healthz appeared in generated API docs.
bugs.root_cause: Phase 0 implemented only a subset of protected route skeletons even though the implementation plan requires contract path coverage and protected skeletons before product workflows.
bugs.fix: Added protected skeleton routes for the active contract path set, switched path templates to exact OpenAPI names, hid /healthz from generated API docs, and added an OpenAPI path parity regression test.

bugs.error_message: mypy reported 51 errors across DB, auth, jobs, and contracts modules.
bugs.root_cause: The psycopg dict-row connection boundary and migration cursors were under-typed, causing downstream row access to be treated as tuple/object access.
bugs.fix: Typed the shared DB connection as dict-row based, added explicit non-null checks for database RETURNING rows, tightened contract/job helper return types, and added mypy/Pyright to the SAST target.

bugs.error_message: ruff format --check reported four files would be reformatted.
bugs.root_cause: Phase 0 lint ran ruff check but had not enforced ruff format conformance on all Python files.
bugs.fix: Applied ruff formatting and verified the full repository with ruff format --check.

bugs.error_message: Dedicated SAST tools were unavailable; after installation, Semgrep reported root-running Docker containers and Bandit reported bind/query concerns.
bugs.root_cause: The repository had no codified SAST target and the Phase 0 Dockerfiles did not set non-root runtime users.
bugs.fix: Added a make sast target with Bandit, Semgrep, Pyright, and mypy; added dev dependencies; made Docker images run as non-root users; changed default bind hosts to localhost unless Compose explicitly opts into container binding; and rewrote dynamic job-list SQL as fixed query branches.

bugs.error_message: Phase 1 live/integration/runtime validation was run and reported from the Mac instead of the intended GPU node.
bugs.root_cause: The GPU node completion policy in STRUCTURA_PLAN_INDEX.md was not carried forward into the active agent guidance before running milestone validation.
bugs.fix: Persisted the GPU node policy in agents.md and OpenWolf: commit and push locally, SSH to bgconley@10.25.0.50 with the configured key, pull into /tank/repos/structura, keep venvs under /tank/venvs, and run milestone build/test evidence on the GPU node using /srv/structura runtime mounts.

bugs.error_message: User corrected the statement that /tank/repos needed to be created; /tank/repos already exists on the GPU node.
bugs.root_cause: The guidance included conditional create language before verifying the live GPU-node filesystem and ZFS dataset state.
bugs.fix: Inspected the GPU node with zfs list, zpool list, findmnt, df, ls, and docker info; updated agents.md and OpenWolf to require inspection before creation and recorded the observed state: tank/repos exists, /tank/repos/structura exists, /tank/venvs exists on root ext4, /srv/structura and tank/structura runtime datasets are absent.

bugs.error_message: GPU-node ZFS bootstrap created writable runtime bind mounts owned by bgconley/root instead of the API worker container UID 10001.
bugs.root_cause: The script used the host operator owner for writable app paths, but apps/api/Dockerfile runs API, worker, and model containers as non-root UID 10001 on Linux bind mounts.
bugs.fix: Updated the script to chown objects, models, staging, cache, logs, and tmp to 10001:bgconley with group-write permissions while preserving repo and venv host conventions.

bugs.error_message: GPU-node bootstrap failed: pip install -e .[dev] reported multiple top-level packages discovered in a flat-layout.
bugs.root_cause: The project used setuptools auto-discovery in a flat repository containing non-package top-level directories such as database, contracts, and infrastructure.
bugs.fix: Configured setuptools package discovery to include only apps*, lib*, and workers* so editable installs can be used for GPU-node test environments.

bugs.error_message: GPU-node make sast failed because mypy reported missing library stubs for yaml.
bugs.root_cause: The dev extra included types-jsonschema but omitted types-PyYAML even though lib/contracts/registry.py imports yaml.
bugs.fix: Added types-PyYAML to the dev optional dependencies so GPU-node venv bootstrap installs the stubs required by mypy.

bugs.error_message: GPU-node Playwright test dirtied tracked screenshot evidence files under docs/ui-reference.
bugs.root_cause: The E2E test wrote screenshots directly to committed reference paths instead of Playwright's per-run test output directory.
bugs.fix: Changed screenshots to use testInfo.outputPath so runtime screenshots are captured as ignored test artifacts and committed reference screenshots remain stable.

bugs.error_message: Phase 1 had no browser smoke test against the live Compose API and database stack.
bugs.root_cause: The existing Playwright workflow mocked API responses, while live API/storage/database behavior was verified separately by integration tests.
bugs.fix: Added an opt-in STRUCTURA_E2E_LIVE=1 Playwright test that logs in, uploads a document, opens the viewer, and asserts protected asset URLs through the real web/API/Postgres stack.

bugs.error_message: GPU-node web container served HTTP 200 but Docker Compose marked it unhealthy.
bugs.root_cause: The web healthcheck used localhost, which can resolve to IPv6 inside the Alpine container while the Node static server listens on IPv4 0.0.0.0.
bugs.fix: Changed the web healthcheck URL to http://127.0.0.1:3000 so it checks the IPv4 listener directly.

bugs.error_message: Cross-household job/admin visibility was allowed; another household could read a job status and admin job listings were not tenant scoped.
bugs.root_cause: Job/admin routes used authenticated principals without enforcing household ownership and admin role/scope rules across job read/list/retry surfaces.
bugs.fix: Added household role to auth principals, added admin dependencies, scoped job create/read/list/retry by household, updated upload job creation to carry household_id, and added cross-household/admin regression coverage.

bugs.error_message: Manual retry of a dead-letter job could set status back to queued while attempt_count still prevented any worker from claiming it.
bugs.root_cause: retry_job cleared dead-letter status but did not reset attempt_count or stale worker/lease/error fields, while claim_next_job requires attempt_count < max_attempts.
bugs.fix: Changed manual retry to reset attempt_count to 0, clear lease/worker/start/finish/error fields, schedule the job immediately, and added regression coverage proving retried dead-letter jobs are claimable.

bugs.error_message: The web API proxy buffered full upload request bodies and upstream response bodies in memory.
bugs.root_cause: The static web proxy used Buffer.concat for incoming requests and arrayBuffer() for upstream responses, defeating streaming/backpressure expectations for large uploads/downloads.
bugs.fix: Reworked the proxy to stream request bodies into fetch with duplex half mode, pipe upstream response streams back to the client, preserve headers safely, and keep explicit body-size guarding.

bugs.error_message: Preview jobs were marked retryable, but the Compose preview worker still ran a placeholder and upload generated previews inline.
bugs.root_cause: The Phase 1/2 preview pipeline had queue records but no active consumer, so recovery depended on API upload-side side effects rather than worker claim/complete/fail semantics.
bugs.fix: Added a real preview worker loop and shared worker runtime health server, moved preview generation to the worker path, changed upload to enqueue preview jobs only, and updated integration tests to process the matching document's preview job deterministically.

bugs.error_message: The UI screenshot gate captured screenshots but did not fully enforce deterministic comparisons or include complete Phase 2 Figma source artifacts.
bugs.root_cause: Phase 1/2 Playwright tests used procedural screenshots without complete committed reference coverage for the folder/tag filing composite Figma source set.
bugs.fix: Added Playwright toHaveScreenshot assertions and Linux baselines, captured Phase 2 folder/tag filing Figma and handoff artifacts, documented the composite source set, and committed the Playwright comparison screenshot.

bugs.error_message: Docling conversion in the dedicated worker failed with ImportError: libxcb.so.1: cannot open shared object file.
bugs.root_cause: The Python Docling dependency stack installed successfully, but the slim worker image did not include native OpenCV/PDF pipeline shared libraries required by Docling's table model path.
bugs.fix: Added the required native runtime libraries to the worker-docling image while keeping Docling/Torch isolated from API and preview images.

bugs.error_message: Docling/RapidOCR attempted to download OCR model files into Python site-packages and failed with PermissionError.
bugs.root_cause: The worker relied on Docling's default PDF pipeline, which initializes OCR and RapidOCR model downloads even for the simple digital-PDF smoke, and RapidOCR's default model root was inside the installed package path.
bugs.fix: Configured Docling's PDF pipeline explicitly, disabled OCR by default for Phase 3 digital-PDF conversion, and set runtime cache environment paths under /srv/structura/cache for future OCR/model enablement.

bugs.error_message: Same-household non-owner users could list, open, and download assets for documents filed in private folders.
bugs.root_cause: Document and asset read queries enforced household membership only and did not apply the documented folder/document/sensitivity ACL predicate.
bugs.fix: Added the baseline database function document_is_readable, applied it to document list/detail/assets and organization write locking, and added same-household private-folder negative integration coverage.

bugs.error_message: Two households could not create the same folder name at the same parent level; the second create could return HTTP 500.
bugs.root_cause: The original folders_parent_name_uniq index scoped uniqueness by parent/name only and ignored household_id.
bugs.fix: Added a forward migration that replaces the global index with household-scoped and system-folder-scoped unique indexes, plus deterministic 409 handling for unique races.

bugs.error_message: Claimed jobs in running status could remain permanently stuck after worker crash or lease abandonment.
bugs.root_cause: claim_next_job_record only considered queued/failed jobs and retry_job rejected running jobs even when their leases had expired.
bugs.fix: Added stale running-job recovery before claim, dead-lettering when attempts are exhausted, and allowed admin retry of expired running jobs only; added integration regression coverage.

bugs.error_message: Phase 3 parse-debug UI did not have an enforced screenshot baseline or committed reference artifact set.
bugs.root_cause: The parse-debug browser test asserted text only and docs/ui-reference lacked a parse-debug reference folder.
bugs.fix: Added deterministic Playwright screenshot assertion, committed the Linux snapshot, added parse-debug comparison notes/context, and refreshed viewer/folder filing screenshots after the Phase 3 panel changed current UI height.

bugs.error_message: The web client hardcoded structura_csrf and would fail mutating requests if backend CSRF cookie names were customized.
bugs.root_cause: The backend already supported configurable cookie names, but SessionInfo did not expose them and the frontend always read the default CSRF cookie.
bugs.fix: Extended SessionInfo/OpenAPI with sessionCookieName and csrfCookieName, configured the web client from the session response, and added mocked browser coverage for a custom CSRF cookie name.

bugs.error_message: Phase 3 live browser validation was missing from the canonical GPU Playwright suite.
bugs.root_cause: Phase 3 had GPU backend integration coverage and mocked Playwright screenshot coverage, but no live browser spec was added to exercise the GPU-hosted web/API/DB/Docling path.
bugs.fix: Added tests/e2e/phase3-live.spec.ts with deterministic PDF upload, live Docling parse polling, and Viewer Parse Debug assertions; added tests/e2e/support/pdf.ts; updated README/agents guidance and OpenWolf memory so all implemented phase live specs must be included.

bugs.error_message: make sast failed with Bandit B608 hardcoded_sql_expressions findings in lib/search/repository.py.
bugs.root_cause: Phase 5 search SQL used f-string query construction for internal filter predicate composition and vector casts, which Bandit flags even when values are parameterized.
bugs.fix: Refactored search repository queries to use psycopg.sql composition for internal predicates, removed dynamic vector dimension casts from SQL text, and preserved parameterized user/filter values.

bugs.error_message: Phase 5 mocked Playwright test could not click the Search nav button and initially snapshotted after navigating away from the search surface.
bugs.root_cause: The sidebar button's accessible name includes the icon letter, so /^Search$/ did not match; the screenshot assertion was placed after the evidence-jump navigation to the viewer.
bugs.fix: Changed the locator to match /Search/, moved the screenshot assertion before the evidence jump, added explicit filter selection, and generated the Linux Phase 5 search snapshot.

bugs.error_message: GPU integration run failed because Phase 4 tests asserted direct worker claims while live Compose workers could process extraction jobs first.
bugs.root_cause: The integration tests assumed an idle queue and asserted process_next_extraction_job returned true, which is brittle when the canonical GPU stack has background extraction workers running.
bugs.fix: Changed Phase 4 integration tests to drain jobs opportunistically and wait for persisted candidates/canonical fields/job success, making them valid against both idle test DBs and live worker stacks.

bugs.error_message: Phase 5 GPU integration search test returned no lexical items for the target document.
bugs.root_cause: The fixture marked the document user_confirmed while also sending reviewedOnly=false, so the ACL/filter path could correctly exclude it until a concurrent extraction worker changed review_status.
bugs.fix: Removed the contradictory reviewedOnly filter from the lexical assertion, included the unique marker in semantic search, and asserted target presence by document ID instead of assuming rank 1 in a shared live DB.

bugs.error_message: The canonical live Playwright suite failed Phase 3 after Phase 5 because the Parse Debug panel listed only the six newest jobs and hid the older docling_convert success.
bugs.root_cause: Phase 5 added downstream classify/extract/embed jobs, so a recency-only parse-debug job list could omit the Phase 3 canonical parse job even though parse artifacts were present and healthy.
bugs.fix: Changed the Parse Debug panel display helper to always preserve a docling_convert job in the visible list while still capping the list to six rows.

bugs.error_message: Phase 5 live Playwright evidence jump failed strict mode because multiple search results exposed identically named Jump to evidence buttons.
bugs.root_cause: The live shared GPU database can contain previous search results, so a page-wide evidence-jump locator is ambiguous even when the target result is present.
bugs.fix: Scoped Phase 5 mocked and live evidence-jump locators to the matching search-result card before clicking Jump to evidence.

bugs.error_message: Phase 5 live Playwright reached the correct evidence target but failed because the Viewer status did not contain the exact hyphenated query marker.
bugs.root_cause: The search evidence snippet is generated from tokenized/highlighted search text, so hyphenated markers can be split or partially highlighted even when the evidence target is correct.
bugs.fix: Changed the live evidence assertion to verify the unique run id and stable evidence text rather than the exact hyphenated query marker.
